#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <regex>

int main() {
    std::string input;
    std::getline(std::cin, input);
    int finalCount = 0;
    if (!input.empty()) {
        std::regex pattern("(.)\\1*");
        auto words_begin = std::sregex_iterator(input.begin(), input.end(), pattern);
        auto words_end = std::sregex_iterator();
        int seqCounter = 1;
        for (std::sregex_iterator i = words_begin; i != words_end; ++i) {
            std::smatch match = *i;
            seqCounter += match.str().length() - 1;
            if (seqCounter % 2 == 0) {
                finalCount++;
                seqCounter = 1;
            }
        }
    }
    std::cout << finalCount << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
